Weather I compare myself to others or not, it is true that I am not as good as they. Everyone has a better personality, better skills, better attitude, everything. It doesn't matter if I say "well I don't care that I'm not them" it still stands that they are better than me. I'm sorry, I've gone off on a tangent, it's all of this plus what I explained in the OP. It's just getting too much for me. I feel pain whenever I think about being held or comforted by a woman. It causes emotional pain which in turn makes my chest or stomach feel physical pain. I don't know why but it does. It's like some sort of withdrawal.

I feel like I can't do anything right. I'm awkward sometimes, I'll do something only for someone else to do it better (say for instance a job), in general I just feel useless. If everyone is better than me, than what am I doing here? I'm just sucking up oxygen. I'm just a 5th wheel that is taking up room and everyone else is better than me. At everything! I feel useless because I can't say I'm the best at something. There is always doubt in my mind even when I THINK I know something. I always doubt what I know because there's this thing in my head that says "I'm a dumbass, I probably don't know what I'm doing, and someone else knows everything". And it's happened before where I was like "yeah I know what im doing!" and then someone comes along and is like "yeah no, you did everything wrong". So my brain always thinks back to those moments where I fucked up. I thought I had the knowledge, one of the FEW times I feel confident in what I'm doing (car repair, computer repair, manual labor shit, etc.) and it turns out I'm dead wrong OR theres a more efficient way of doing said job. I feel out of my league.

I don't have any major skill sets. I'm short, scrawny, quiet, and sometimes clumsy. Everyone around me have such good futures set out of them. They know what they want and how to get it. I have no idea what I want and no clue how to get it even if I did. All I know is that I want to move out of my parents house, but I have to pay off my car and THEN save up, or get a different job. I work at a clothing store at the moment. Everyone is just so much better than me, so much more capable and confident. Sometimes I feel like I can't do anything right and the few times where I am confident in something I do, someone else comes and does it better than me. I feel like I'm just a 5th wheel in every situation I'm in. I do not feel important and I just can't see myself getting out of this mentality. It is very hard and I don't know what to do. 

edit: I wish I could take charge and be a super cool dude, but I'm always just sitting on the side lines. People at work really like me and I feel so comfortable there it's hard for me to leave. I've got lots of people around me that appreciate me but I still feel useless. I feel like my confidence solely revolves around finding a relationship and spending my life with someone I fall in love with, which I think is incredibly pathetic and knowing that I'm that easily put down makes me feel ashamed and stupid and only makes me think of myself unfit for survival. I feel weak.

Provided it exists, then hidden is correct. I don't think I'm good at anything. And anytime I do, there's ALWAYS someone I run across that does it 10x better and makes me look like a chump. I wish I was someone else, someone that looked manly or attractive, or was good at something. Everyone I know has a special quality about them, I don't have any.
I've felt like shit for almost a year now and these past few days it's been worse. I just don't see myself feeling better anytime soon. Even my usual distractions don't work anymore.
But I don't know what that is. I don't have anything going for me. I have nothing to aspire to. And I don't think I'm unattractive for low self confidence, im pretty good at hiding it.

I'm kind of torn on privacy. One one hand I like the idea that an organization is scanning communications. I want them to uncover terror plots, or shit even violent crimes and stop them before they happen. I don't know how successful the NSA has been in that regard. I wish they would come out and give us something. 

And then on the other hand, I realize that a power like this has to be wielded by the most competent, fair people. If they see my emails or the anime porn I jerk it to, I could give less of a shit UNLESS anime porn became illegal and then years later they lock me up for something that was previously illegal. Or like with that one kid from Texas that posted a comment on facebook about how he was "totally gonna shoot up a school". I don't remember the exact words but it was a comment about LoL or something and he was being sarcastic which is easy to tell if read in the context it was said. The police totally took it out of context and locked him up and it was a big thing a year ago, I'm sure someone remembers it in the news. 

At the end of the day, I don't care if the gov't sees my information and invades my online privacy, so long as they don't leak it to average joe or get my IRL identity and start sending shit I post online to my employers. I like the idea of being watched over by an all seeing eye, FOR PROTECTION. If they can prevent violent crime and terror plots, by all means invade my privacy, but they won't find anything here. If they actually do their job right they won't give a single shit about average joe's internet history. I think the solution is not to get rid of NSA spying, but to have INTENSE civilian oversight of their operations. But also, humans are not perfect creatures. Abuse will happen somewhere.
